messages:
Rina S (IC): Hi  returning from a 5-day customer ramp in Stockholm. I did 4 business days and added 1 personal day at the end. Policy says per-diem only for business days. How do I submit meals for the final day? I paid for breakfast/lunch on personal day but dinner was with a customer.

expense-bot: Reminder: Per-diem applies to documented business days. For mixed days, split expenses or use itemized lines.

Ava R (People Ops): Submit one expense report for the trip. For the personal day, add separate expense lines: mark personal meals as "Personal - Not Reimbursable" and record the customer dinner as reimbursable with a note of attendees. Attach the calendar invite or meeting notes for the dinner.

Rina S (IC): OK. I have a calendar invite for the dinner + a card receipt showing dinner 80. Breakfasts/lunches on the personal day were cash and small. Can I claim per-diem for the 4 business days instead of uploading every meal receipt?

Oscar D (Finance): Yes — for full business days you can pick the per-diem rate. In the form: select "Per-diem (Sweden)" and list dates. Add a separate line for the client dinner (attach invite). Personal day meals should be left off or marked as personal. If cash receipts are missing for personal items, flag them as non-reimbursable.

Marta P (Manager): Approved for the client dinner. Marta: "Approved - client meetings 4/10-4/13"

Ava R (People Ops): Process notes: - Use expense type "Per-diem (Country: Sweden)" and indicate the covered dates. - For split days, add a line "Personal day - meals excluded" with the date. - Upload the calendar invite or a short attestation for the client dinner showing attendees. - For EUR -> USD conversion use the transaction date rate (we accept xe.com or Google; paste link or screenshot). - If expense-bot flags OCR issues, reply here with the expense id and we'll route to manual review.

Rina S (IC): Uploaded per-diem selection + dinner receipt + calendar invite. Thanks!

expense-bot: Expense 1905004399 submitted: awaiting finance review.
